turns.q: My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
turns.replyTail:
Your order number (or, if you don’t have it handy, the name and shipping address on the order)
The name of the item that seems damaged
A few photos showing:
The whole item

The box and any packing material, if it looks like it was handled roughly
